previous_description: Groups all HTTP operations available under a single URL path pattern (e.g., /users/{userId}). Path-level parameters apply to all operations under the path and can be overridden by matching name+in at the operation level, but cannot be removed. Individual HTTP methods are represented as operation references. Supports $ref at the PathItem level, enabling shared path definitions to be reused across multiple OpenAPI specifications.
definition: An OpenAPI path-level object that groups the HTTP operations exposed under exactly one URL path template (e.g. /users/{userId}), or under one callback runtime expression. It carries parameters and servers shared by all of those operations. It describes the whole path, not any single method.

distinguish_from.when: the element is one HTTP method on the path (e.g. GET /users/{userId}) with its own operationId, request body and responses
the element is the document-wide map from every path template to its PathItem, not a single path entry
the element is the runtime-expression key (e.g. $request.body#/callbackUrl) naming where an asynchronous notification is sent, rather than the PathItem that key maps to
the element is a single named input (path, query, header or cookie), even if it is declared at path level and shared by all operations

code_evidence: a key beginning with '/' directly under 'paths:' in an OpenAPI YAML/JSON file, whose children are HTTP-method keys (get, post, put, delete) and optionally a shared 'parameters' or 'servers' list
a router chain bound to one path string with several verb handlers, e.g. Express router.route('/users/:id').get(...).put(...).delete(...)
a class-based view bound to a single URL pattern whose methods are named after HTTP verbs, e.g. a Flask MethodView or Django APIView registered at path('users/<int:id>/', ...)

attribute_descriptions.name: summary
attribute_descriptions.description: Optional short one-line plain-text summary intended to apply to all operations under this path; set it when the path as a whole has a single clear purpose (e.g. 'Single user resource').

attribute_descriptions.name: description
attribute_descriptions.description: Optional longer explanation, in CommonMark Markdown, of the resource or behaviour shared by all operations under this path; set it when path-wide context (semantics, constraints) is not captured by individual operation descriptions.

notes: No attribute holds the path template itself (the map key) or the PathItem-level $ref. api.operation duplicates the path in http_path. Cross-layer relations (realizes businessfunction, requires securitypolicy, depends-on technologyservice) overlap with the same relations at operation level. The pathitem→pathitem 'references' relation stands in for $ref but is listed twice.
